2.10 SD Card Photo Gallery

Browsing and displaying BMP images stored on the SD card with a touch-friendly gallery UI.

Overview

This project creates a photo viewer app that scans the SD card for BMP images and displays them with forward/back navigation. It combines file system operations, image rendering, and UI navigation.

What You’ll Learn

  • Scanning a directory for specific file types (.bmp)

  • Building a linked list of file paths in memory

  • Displaying BMP images from SD card using LVGL

  • Implementing gallery-style navigation (previous, next, home)

How the Code Works

Scanning the SD Card

On startup, the gallery scans /picture/ for .bmp files and builds a linked list:

struct PhotoNode {
    String filename;
    PhotoNode *next;
};

void scanPhotos(fs::FS &fs, const char *path, PhotoNode **head) {
    File dir = fs.open(path);
    while (true) {
        File entry = dir.openNextFile();
        if (!entry) break;
        if (String(entry.name()).endsWith(".bmp")) {
            // Add to linked list
        }
    }
}

Navigation Buttons

  • Left arrow: previous photo

  • Right arrow: next photo

  • Home/ESC icon: return to gallery list overview

Expected Result

  1. Before uploading, create a /picture/ folder on the SD card and place some 240×240 BMP images inside.

  2. The gallery displays the first photo with navigation buttons.

  3. Use the left/right buttons to browse through all images on the card.

Note

Images should be resized to 240×240 pixels in BMP format for optimal display. Larger images will be cropped.
